sentences.text:

Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13771 of 2023

Applicant :- Devraj Rathore Alias Devendra Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Tej Om Prakash Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Tej Om Prakash Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pradeep Kumar,
learned AGA for the State.
2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 376 of 2021, under Sections 328 and 304 IPC, Police Station Kotwali, District Etawah during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 03.09.2021 against applicant and one unknown person and according to the FIR applicant has taken the deceased on 26.08.2021 and after committing his murder threw his dead body at the bus stand.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that only evidence against the applicant was of last seen on the basis of statement of the informant but during trial informant was declared hostile,

sentences.text: therefore, the only evidence of last seen against the applicant has also gone.

He further submits applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 21.08.2022.
5.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that only evidence against the applicant was of last seen and informant of the case during trial has turned hostile.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. From the perusal of record, it appears that only evidence against the applicant was of last seen and except the last seen evidence there was no evidence against the applicant on record but during trial informant of the case was declared hostile.
Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 21.08.2022 i.e. for almost a year.

8. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Devraj Rathore Alias Devendra Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023
